'''Fleet Support Air Station''' was located on<ref name="RC:HC" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] as an auxiliary of [[Fleet Support]] and was in service by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="RC:HC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> About three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the station contained a [[Nar Shaddaa agri-utility crop sprayer]] in [[Docking Bay D-768]], which was used by the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Omega Squad]] on their [[Mission to Qiilura|mission]] to apprehend [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]] on the nearby world [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]].<ref name="RC:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fleet Support Air Station appeared in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|Hard Contact]]'', the first novel in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" />
